crf.title: Crf
crf.description: CRF (quality) for H264 encoding. Lower values = higher quality.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Set a seed for reproducibility. Random by default.

lora_url.title: Lora Url
lora_url.description: A URL pointing to your LoRA .safetensors file or a Hugging Face repo (e.g. 'user/repo' - uses the first .safetensors file).

scheduler.description: Algorithm used to generate the video frames.

num_frames.title: Num Frames
num_frames.description: How many frames (duration) in the resulting video.

enhance_end.title: Enhance End
enhance_end.description: When to end enhancement in the video. Must be greater than enhance_start.

enhance_start.title: Enhance Start
enhance_start.description: When to start enhancement in the video. Must be less than enhance_end.

force_offload.title: Force Offload
force_offload.description: Whether to force model layers offloaded to CPU.

enhance_weight.title: Enhance Weight
enhance_weight.description: Strength of the video enhancement effect.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Overall influence of text vs. model.

denoise_strength.title: Denoise Strength
denoise_strength.description: Controls how strongly noise is applied each step.

replicate_weights.title: Replicate Weights
replicate_weights.description: A .tar file containing LoRA weights from replicate.

optimizer.title: optimizer
optimizer.description: An enumeration.

scheduler.title: scheduler
scheduler.description: An enumeration.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: LoRA rank for training. Higher ranks take longer to train but can capture more complex features. Caption quality is more important for higher ranks.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for training. Use <=0 for random.

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Each epoch processes all your videos once. Note: If max_train_steps is set, training may end before completing all epochs.

hf_token.title: Hf Token
hf_token.description: Hugging Face token, if you'd like to upload the trained LoRA to Hugging Face.

optimizer.description: Optimizer type for training. If you're unsure, leave as default.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Batch size for training. Lower values use less memory but train slower.

hf_repo_id.title: Hf Repo Id
hf_repo_id.description: Hugging Face repository ID, if you'd like to upload the trained LoRA to Hugging Face. For example, username/my-video-lora. If the given repo does not exist, a new public repo will be created.

frame_sample.title: Frame Sample
frame_sample.description: Number of samples for 'uniform' extraction method.

input_videos.title: Input Videos
input_videos.description: A zip file containing videos that will be used for training. If you include captions, include them as one .txt file per video, e.g. my-video.mp4 should have a caption file named my-video.txt. If you don't include captions, you can use autocaptioning (enabled by default).

trigger_word.title: Trigger Word
trigger_word.description: The trigger word refers to the object, style or concept you are training on. Pick a string that isn't a real word, like TOK or something related to what's being trained, like STYLE3D. The trigger word you specify here will be associated with all videos during training. Then when you use your LoRA, you can include the trigger word in prompts to help activate the LoRA.

learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: Learning rate for training. If you're new to training you probably don't need to change this.

max_train_steps.title: Max Train Steps
max_train_steps.description: Maximum number of training steps to perform. Each step processes one batch of frames. Set to -1 to train for the full number of epochs. If positive, training will stop after this many steps even if all epochs aren't complete.

timestep_sampling.description: Controls how timesteps are sampled during training. 'sigmoid' (default) concentrates samples in the middle of the diffusion process. 'uniform' samples evenly across all timesteps. 'sigma' samples based on the noise schedule. 'shift' uses shifted sampling with discrete flow shift. If unsure, use 'sigmoid'.

autocaption_prefix.title: Autocaption Prefix
autocaption_prefix.description: Optional: Text you want to appear at the beginning of all your generated captions; for example, 'a video of TOK, '. You can include your trigger word in the prefix. Prefixes help set the right context for your captions.

autocaption_suffix.title: Autocaption Suffix
autocaption_suffix.description: Optional: Text you want to appear at the end of all your generated captions; for example, ' in the style of TOK'. You can include your trigger word in suffixes. Suffixes help set the right concept for your captions.

frame_extraction_method.description: Method to extract frames from videos during training.

consecutive_target_frames.description: The lengths of consecutive frames to extract from each video.

trigger_word.title: Trigger Word
trigger_word.description: The trigger word refers to the object, style or concept you are training on. learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

max_train_steps.title: Max Train Steps
max_train_steps.description: Maximum number of training steps to perform. Each step processes one batch of frames. Set to -1 to train for the full number of epochs. If positive, training will stop after this many steps even if all epochs aren't complete.

timestep_sampling.description: Controls how timesteps are sampled during training. 'sigmoid' (default) concentrates samples in the middle of the diffusion process. trigger_word.title: Trigger Word
trigger_word.description: The trigger word refers to the object, style or concept you are training on. learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: Learning rate for training. If you're new to training you probably don't need to change this.

max_train_steps.title: Max Train Steps
max_train_steps.description: Maximum number of training steps to perform. Each step processes one batch of frames. Set to -1 to train for the full number of epochs. If positive, training will stop after this many steps even if all epochs aren't complete.

timestep_sampling.description: Controls how timesteps are sampled during training. 'sigmoid' (default) concentrates samples in the middle of the diffusion process. autocaption_prefix.title: Autocaption Prefix

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: LoRA rank for training. Higher ranks take longer to train but can capture more complex features. Caption quality is more important for higher ranks.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for training. Use <=0 for random.

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Each epoch processes all your videos once. Note: If max_train_steps is set, training may end before completing all epochs.

hf_token.title: Hf Token
hf_token.description: Hugging Face token, if you'd like to upload the trained LoRA to Hugging Face.

optimizer.description: Optimizer type for training. If you're unsure, leave as default.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Batch size for training. Lower values use less memory but train slower.

hf_repo_id.title: Hf Repo Id
hf_repo_id.description: Hugging Face repository ID, if you'd like to upload the trained LoRA to Hugging Face. For example, username/my-video-lora. If the given repo does not exist, a new public repo will be created.

frame_sample.title: Frame Sample
frame_sample.description: Number of samples for 'uniform' extraction method.

input_videos.title: Input Videos
input_videos.description: A zip file containing videos that will be used for training. If you include captions, include them as one .txt file per video, e.g. my-video.mp4 should have a caption file named my-video.txt. If you don't include captions, you can use autocaptioning (enabled by default).

trigger_word.title: Trigger Word
trigger_word.description: The trigger word refers to the object, style or concept you are training on. Pick a string that isn't a real word, like TOK or something related to what's being trained, like STYLE3D. The trigger word you specify here will be associated with all videos during training. Then when you use your LoRA, you can include the trigger word in prompts to help activate the LoRA.

learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: Learning rate for training. If you're new to training you probably don't need to change this.

max_train_steps.title: Max Train Steps
max_train_steps.description: Maximum number of training steps to perform. Each step processes one batch of frames. Set to -1 to train for the full number of epochs. If positive, training will stop after this many steps even if all epochs aren't complete.

timestep_sampling.description: Controls how timesteps are sampled during training. 'sigmoid' (default) concentrates samples in the middle of the diffusion process. 'uniform' samples evenly across all timesteps. 'sigma' samples based on the noise schedule. 'shift' uses shifted sampling with discrete flow shift. If unsure, use 'sigmoid'.

autocaption_prefix.title: Autocaption Prefix
autocaption_prefix.description: Optional: Text you want to appear at the beginning of all your generated captions; for example, 'a video of TOK, '. You can include your trigger word in the prefix. Prefixes help set the right context for your captions.

autocaption_suffix.title: Autocaption Suffix
autocaption_suffix.description: Optional: Text you want to appear at the end of all your generated captions; for example, ' in the style of TOK'. You can include your trigger word in suffixes. Suffixes help set the right concept for your captions.

frame_extraction_method.description: Method to extract frames from videos during training.

consecutive_target_frames.description: The lengths of consecutive frames to extract from each video.

seed.description: Random seed for training. Use <=0 for random.

epochs.description: Number of training epochs. Each epoch processes all your videos once. Note: If max_train_steps is set, training may end before completing all epochs.

batch_size.description: Batch size for training. Lower values use less memory but train slower.

hf_repo_id.description: Hugging Face repository ID, if you'd like to upload the trained LoRA to Hugging Face. For example, username/my-video-lora. If the given repo does not exist, a new public repo will be created.

frame_sample.title: Frame Sample
frame_sample.description: Number of samples for 'uniform' extraction method.

input_videos.title: Input Videos
input_videos.description: A zip file containing videos that will be used for training. If you include captions, include them as one .txt file per video, e.g. my-video.mp4 should have a caption file named my-video.txt. If you don't include captions, you can use autocaptioning (enabled by default).

trigger_word.title: Trigger Word
trigger_word.description: The trigger word refers to the object, style or concept you are training on. Pick a string that isn't a real word, like TOK or something related to what's being trained, like STYLE3D. The trigger word you specify here will be associated with all videos during training. Then when you use your LoRA, you can include the trigger word in prompts to help activate the LoRA.

learning_rate.title: Learning Rate
learning_rate.description: Learning rate for training. If you're new to training you probably don't need to change this.

max_train_steps.title: Max Train Steps
max_train_steps.description: Maximum number of training steps to perform. Each step processes one batch of frames. Set to -1 to train for the full number of epochs. If positive, training will stop after this many steps even if all epochs aren't complete.

timestep_sampling.description: Controls how timesteps are sampled during training. 'sigmoid' (default) concentrates samples in the middle of the diffusion process. 'uniform' samples evenly across all timesteps. 'sigma' samples based on the noise schedule. 'shift' uses shifted sampling with discrete flow shift. If unsure, use 'sigmoid'.

autocaption_prefix.title: Autocaption Prefix
autocaption_prefix.description: Optional: Text you want to appear at the beginning of all your generated captions; for example, 'a video of TOK, '. You can include your trigger word in the prefix. Prefixes help set the right context for your captions.

autocaption_suffix.title: Autocaption Suffix
autocaption_suffix.description: Optional: Text you want to appear at the end of all your generated captions; for example, ' in the style of TOK'. You can include your trigger word in suffixes. Suffixes help set the right concept for your captions.

frame_extraction_method.description: Method to extract frames from videos during training.

consecutive_target_frames.description: The lengths of consecutive frames to extract from each video.
